label: Hook
notes: Cold open on the question. First frame fully composed.

label: Title
notes: Episode title over the first assembled slice of the world.

label: Explain
notes: The workhorse. Nao talks to camera; the board holds a card or live props.

label: Analogy
notes: Physical metaphor. Needs 2+ props and 2+ board items naming the mapping.

label: Diagram
notes: Near-full-frame isometric diagram. Board widens, presenter narrows.

label: Zoom in
notes: Camera pushes to a named prop and pins a label.

label: Step by step
notes: Numbered steps appear one at a time. 2 to 4 board items.

label: Compare
notes: Two vignettes split by a divider. The left one is the misconception.

label: Packet trip
notes: The camera follows one token along a Paths row. Max one per episode.

label: Myth check
notes: A crossed-out claim, then the correct world rebuilds.

label: Recap
notes: Three or four chips summarise the answer. The world dims behind.

label: Outro
notes: One-line takeaway, episode badge, follow prompt.

label: Wide
notes: 0.80 zoom on the grid centre. Hook, title, recap.

label: Board
notes: 1.00 zoom, board centre. The default.

label: Close
notes: 1.30 zoom on the focused prop.

label: Macro
notes: 1.60 zoom, offset up. Packet trip nodes.

label: Tilt up
notes: 1.00 zoom, panned up 120px. Tall props.

label: Split
notes: 0.90 zoom framed for two vignettes. Compare.

label: Pull back
notes: 0.80 to 1.00 animated across the beat. Outro.

label: Talk hands
notes: Small circular hand movement for the beat.

label: Point board
notes: Arm extends toward the board and holds.

label: Point camera
notes: One hand toward the viewer. Hook.

label: Sweep wide
notes: One arm sweeps across the whole board.

label: Present open
notes: Both palms up, offering the board.

label: Holding phone
notes: Holds the phone prop at chest height.

label: Holding tablet
notes: Holds the tablet prop at chest height.

label: Count one
notes: One finger. Matches step 1.

label: Count two
notes: Two fingers. Matches step 2.

label: Count three
notes: Three fingers. Matches step 3.

label: Tap step
notes: Taps the active step chip.

label: Arms crossed
notes: Arms folded. Mild refusal, deadpan.

label: Hands on hips
notes: Squared up. Compare and myth-check.

label: Shake no
notes: Head shake, two cycles.

label: Nod
notes: Head nod, two cycles.

label: Finger heart
notes: The channel sign-off. Outro only.

label: Peace sign
notes: Light sign-off alternative.

label: Shrug
notes: Shoulders and palms up, then down.

label: Settle
notes: Return to neutral after a gesture.

label: Present wide
notes: Both arms open, framing the whole world. Title beats.

label: Standing neutral
notes: Feet together, arms low. Default.

label: Pointing / explaining
notes: One arm to the board, weight on one leg.

label: Presenting palm up
notes: Both palms up, open posture.

label: Holding tablet
notes: Tablet held, looking at the viewer.

label: Thinking
notes: Finger to chin, hip out.

label: Cheerful jump
notes: Available. Reads best on a recap or a delighted beat.

label: Sitting cross-legged
notes: Available. Works best in CORNER and POV shots.

label: Lying down
notes: Available. Works best in CORNER and POV shots.

label: Open palm
notes: Neutral open hand.

label: Point up
notes: Index up. Counting.

label: Point right
notes: Index to the right. Points at a prop.

label: Point left
notes: Index to the left. Mirrored for the prop's side.

label: Thumbs up
notes: Agreement, encouragement.

label: OK sign
notes: That's right.

label: Peace sign
notes: Light, friendly.

label: Stop palm
notes: Do not do this.

label: Fist
notes: Emphasis.

label: Palm up present
notes: Offering the board.

label: Palm out welcome
notes: Welcome, here we go.

label: Index touch
notes: Thinking.

label: Finger heart
notes: Sign-off.

label: Holding pen
notes: Holds a pen prop.

label: Holding phone
notes: Holds the phone prop.

label: Holding tablet
notes: Holds the tablet prop.

label: Holding cup
notes: Holds the cup prop.

label: Arms crossed
notes: Folded arms.

label: Neutral
notes: Resting, half-lidded calm.

label: Happy
notes: Closed smile, soft brows.

label: Smiling (eyes closed)
notes: Full smile, eyes shut.

label: Excited
notes: Open mouth, bright eyes.

label: Surprised
notes: Wide eyes, small open mouth. Hooks and reveals.

label: Confused
notes: Tilted brows, flat mouth.

label: Angry
notes: Low brows, frown. Bad practices only.

label: Sad
notes: Downcast brows. Consequences.

label: Pout
notes: Small mouth, one brow. Deadpan joke.

label: Wink
notes: One eye shut. Playful sign-off.

label: Flirty
notes: Half-lidded, smirk. Max once per episode; never on money, health, privacy or security topics.

label: Blushing
notes: Blush plus soft mouth. An honest admission.

label: Thinking
notes: Eyes up, finger to chin.

label: Shocked
notes: Wide eyes, open mouth. A number that surprises.

label: Laughing
notes: Eyes closed, wide mouth. An absurd truth.

label: Curious (composite)
notes: COMPOSITE: neutral eyes + one brow raised + mouth mid. Used for questions.

label: Focused (composite)
notes: COMPOSITE: half-lidded eyes + furrowed brows + mouth closed. Used for mechanisms.

label: Skeptical (composite)
notes: COMPOSITE: half-lidded eyes + one brow raised + flat mouth. Used for myths.

label: Confident (composite)
notes: COMPOSITE: neutral eyes + soft brows + smile curve. Used for conclusions.

label: Emphatic (composite)
notes: COMPOSITE: neutral eyes + furrowed brows + mouth open. The key sentence.

label: Relieved (composite)
notes: COMPOSITE: half-lidded eyes + soft smile. After a metaphor lands.

label: Sheepish (composite)
notes: COMPOSITE: eyes looking away + blush + flat mouth. An honest caveat.

label: Blank (composite)
notes: COMPOSITE: neutral eyes, no brow accent, mouth closed. A deadpan beat.

label: Delighted (composite)
notes: COMPOSITE: smiling-eyes-closed + blush. A satisfying fact.

label: Casual (default)
notes: Pink tee, charcoal shorts. The default look; topics about your own stuff.

label: Hoodie
notes: Black oversized hoodie. Cold, cosy, evening and outside topics.

label: Sporty
notes: Black crop and shorts. Movement, home, screens in the living room.

label: Casual dress
notes: Off-shoulder top, pink plaid skirt. Bright, weekend, shopping, social.

label: Office casual
notes: White shirt, pencil skirt. Work, money, messages from your bank.

label: Sleepwear
notes: Character pyjamas. Late-night scrolling and 3 a.m. topics.

label: Summer
notes: Two-piece swimwear. In rotation: holidays, heat and travel reels.

label: Compute

label: Network

label: Storage

label: People

label: Abstract
notes: Violets. Clouds, locks, keys, clocks, tokens.

label: Phone
notes: A slab at an angle, screen face up.

label: Laptop
notes: Open clamshell.

label: Router
notes: A flat box with two antennae.

label: Switch
notes: Wide flat box with port notches.

label: Cable
notes: A curved tube between two slots.

label: Tower
notes: A lattice mast with a dish.

label: Cloud
notes: Three overlapping puffs on a plinth.

label: Disk
notes: A stack of three platters.

label: Database
notes: A cylinder with banding.

label: Warehouse
notes: A long shed with a roller door.

label: Shelf
notes: Open frame with four rows of boxes.

label: Envelope
notes: A paper slip with a fold. Floats.

label: Parcel
notes: A taped box.

label: Hand
notes: A stylised flat hand that points.

label: Figure
notes: A blocky 2-unit person with no face.

label: Queue
notes: Four figures on a rail.

label: Lock
notes: A padlock, shackle open or shut.

label: Key
notes: A key that floats and rotates.

label: Clock
notes: A dial with one hand that ticks.

label: Token
notes: A faceted capsule. The travelling packet.

label: Signpost
notes: A post with one or two arrow signs.

label: Board
notes: A leaning diagram panel.

label: Beginner
notes: 6 to 9s beats, 10 to 14 word captions, 1 to 3 props. Assume zero background.

label: Intermediate
notes: 5 to 7s beats, 2 to 4 props. Assume daily use of the web.

label: Advanced
notes: 4 to 6s beats, 3 to 5 props. Assume some technical vocabulary.

label: The Cloud
notes: Where data physically lives: centres, cables, cooling.

label: AI Without the Hype
notes: What AI systems do, minus the marketing.

label: Free and Actually Good
notes: Tools, business models, and who really pays.

label: Small Tech Mysteries
notes: Everyday annoyances explained: wifi, batteries, slow phones.

label: Your Data, Explained
notes: Privacy and data, calmly, without fear-mongering.

label: Draft
notes: Being written.

label: Scripted
notes: Beats complete and sheet:check passes.

label: Built
notes: episode.json compiled and reviewed.

label: Rendered
notes: final.mp4 exists and verify passes.

label: Published
notes: Posted by hand and publishing.md filled.

label: Fade
notes: 10 frame cross-fade. The default.

label: Wipe
notes: 12 frame vertical card wipe aligned to the iso grid.

label: Cut
notes: Hard cut. Use inside step-by-step and compare.

label: Primary
notes: Spec, RFC, or official documentation. Preferred.

label: Secondary
notes: Explainer, blog, or university IT page. Needs a quote.

label: Definition
notes: A standard or glossary entry.

label: Measured
notes: Measured by the author. Say how in the quote.

label: Talking head
notes: Head and shoulders. Full 12 visemes.

label: Mid shot
notes: Full viseme set, mouth region only.

label: Full body
notes: Three states: closed, mid, open.
